column1: # F14 (u5-engine#47): a party loaded with every member asleep (status 'S'),
# then left alone. Measures whether, when and how the stock wakes it - turn
# count, hour, random roll or a key - for cleak/u5-spec#299 Q23. The first
# three minutes send no key at all; Space (Pass) presses follow after that.
# Measured 2026-10-17: the stock party never wakes. It prints a fresh
# `>Zzzzzz...` row (blank row between) on every pass for the whole capture,
# ignores the Space presses, and the panel stays `S`.
# Every beat samples the endless sleep loop, and the stock repeats it on its
# own host-clock cadence, so a shot lands at whatever point of a pass the stock
# is in while the engine is shot between passes. The rc3 sweep
# (20261020-011718) read fourteen beats one row adrift and nothing else. The
# declaration below lets that one-row scroll phase agree on these beats and
# nothing more: the rows themselves (one marker and one sleep row per pass,
# a blank between passes, no `Pass` echo for the ignored Space presses) and
# the roster panel (every member still `S`) are compared on every beat.
# sleep-phase-beats: arrival idle1 idle2 idle3 idle4 idle5 idle6 idle7 idle8 idle9 pass1 pass2 pass3 pass4 pass5 pass6 pass7 pass8 pass9 pass10 pass11 pass12
# requires-seed: the party in a Deceit corridor with every active member's status Sleeping
